meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi tip,它会先拉取当前 tip 列表、核对你自己的 tips 设置与历史,再读源码,用你提问时的语言讲出这条 tip 背后的具体实现机制,而不是复述提示文字。
howto.when: 当你问某条 Tip: 行是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或你自己能看到哪些 tips 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 它会先拉取 tip 列表再讲机制

say.text: 我自己能看到哪些 tips?
say.note: 它会读你的 settings.json 和历史来回答

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条 tip 怎么实现的?
say.note: 它会讲整套 fallback-architect 流程

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, it first pulls the live tip list, checks your own tips settings and history, then reads the source to explain that exact tip's mechanism in the language you asked in, instead of restating the tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a Tip: line means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What was that Tip: line about?
say_en.note: It pulls the tip list before explaining

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and history

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal work?
